title: US firm unveils sensors to track military personnel and supplies at tactical edge | Rune Technologies News
summary: Rune Technologies introduced TyrSense, an NFC-based sensor system that enables military forces to track personnel, casualties, and supplies in battlefield environments without relying on GPS, cloud connectivity, or satellite communications.
body_markdown:
Interesting Engineering covered Rune Technologies by Atharva Gosavi in a piece titled “US firm unveils sensors to track military personnel and supplies at tactical edge.” Rune Technologies introduced TyrSense, an NFC-based sensor system that enables military forces to track personnel, casualties, and supplies in battlefield environments without relying on GPS, cloud connectivity, or satellite communications.


Read the full article[here](https://interestingengineering.com/military/us-firm-unveils-sensors-to-track-military-personnel-and-supplies-at-tactical-edge) .
